purpose: Freeze the successful pilot_9_v6 DataPaginationTable targeted rerun together with the v5 failure baseline, effective prompt/validator code, tests, inputs, and reports.

comparison_to_v5.fixed_error: dom_critical_attribute_mismatch caused by two-way binding on derived disabled expressions

experimental_change: Generation prompt requires one-way interpolation for disabled, checked, and selected derived attributes.
Repair prompt carries the same hard constraint with positive and negative examples.
Validator emits invalid_dynamic_attribute_binding before visual evaluation for forbidden two-way derived bindings.
known_limitations: No DataPaginationTable interaction scenario was configured, so sorting, pagination, page-size changes, row selection, and emitted events were not evaluated by interaction_eval.
The remaining migration_hints_not_landed warning is a validator false positive for the setValue wrapper that delegates to this.data.set.
